description: This source file provides low-level hardware access functions for the RTL8367C PHY, including register read/write operations over OCP and indirect register access mechanisms. It implements functions to set and get PHY and Serdes registers, mainly for hardware configuration and management of the RTL8367C switch.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_setAsicPHYOCPReg(rtk_uint32 phyNo,rtk_uint32 ocpAddr,rtk_uint32 ocpData)
methods.description: Set PHY OCP registers via indirect access or direct access depending on compile-time configuration.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_getAsicPHYOCPReg(rtk_uint32 phyNo,rtk_uint32 ocpAddr,rtk_uint32 * pRegData)
methods.description: Get PHY OCP registers via indirect access or direct access depending on compile-time configuration.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_setAsicPHYReg(rtk_uint32 phyNo,rtk_uint32 phyAddr,rtk_uint32 phyData)
methods.description: Write a value to a specific PHY register at a given PHY address and port.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_getAsicPHYReg(rtk_uint32 phyNo,rtk_uint32 phyAddr,rtk_uint32 * pRegData)
methods.description: Read a value from a specific PHY register at a given PHY address and port.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_setAsicSdsReg(rtk_uint32 sdsId,rtk_uint32 sdsReg,rtk_uint32 sdsPage,rtk_uint32 value)
methods.description: Write to a Serdes register specified by sdsId, sdsReg, and sdsPage.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_getAsicSdsReg(rtk_uint32 sdsId,rtk_uint32 sdsReg,rtk_uint32 sdsPage,rtk_uint32 * value)
methods.description: Read from a Serdes register specified by sdsId, sdsReg, and sdsPage.
